findings.claim: The supplied record does not authorize implementation of either private-journal sharing proposal; both explicitly lack owner acceptance.
The human product owner decides journal disclosure policy; agents may investigate and propose options but cannot approve their own proposal.

Proposal A (2026-11-10) suggests principal access for safeguarding; proposal B (2026-11-11) suggests owner-only journals with explicit person-initiated sharing. Their dates do not establish policy authority.
No implementation evidence is included, so actual behavior and runtime hooks cannot be determined.

decisions.subject: Proposal A: principal access for safeguarding
Proposal B: owner-only with explicit person-initiated sharing
